input_messages.content: Hi! I’d like to make some changes to my upcoming reservation, please.
Sure! My user ID is yara_garcia_1905 and the reservation ID is HXDUBJ.

I’d like to change my outgoing flight to a nonstop flight that departs the next day instead of my current date. Also, I want to move my return flight from SFO back by one day. For both flights, I only want options that depart after 8am and before 9pm.
Yes, those options work for me! Please go ahead and update my reservation to those flights.

Thank you! Actually, I’d also like to upgrade my ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags for both flights. Can you let me know how much that would cost? I’m willing to pay up to $200 for the upgrade and bags. If it’s more than that, I’m okay with keeping economy for the return flight, but I still want to add 2 checked bags.

Let’s go ahead and upgrade just the outgoing flight to business class for $152, and keep economy for the return. Please also make sure I have 2 checked bags on both flights. I’m fine with paying the $152 using my original form of payment.
Yes, please proceed with those changes. Thank you!
That’s fine, please use my original credit card on file to pay for the upgrade. Let me know if you need any more details from me.
Can you please use both of my gift cards first, and then use the travel certificate for any remaining balance? Let me know if that works.
If one gift card can cover the full amount, please just use that one for the upgrade. Go ahead and proceed—thanks!
Yes, please use both gift cards first, and then the travel certificate for any remaining balance. That works for me.

If that’s the case, I’ll just keep economy for both flights. But I still want to add 2 checked bags to each flight. Please go ahead and update my reservation with that. I’m fine with paying for the bags using my original form of payment.
Yes, please add 2 checked bags to each flight. Thanks for confirming there’s no extra charge. That’s all I need!

Thank you for your help! That’s all I needed. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
